<thought>The observed isotopic pattern shows a clear series of peaks spaced ~1.003 Da with relative intensities matching the binomial distribution expected for 13C in a molecule containing ~13 carbons. No characteristic Cl, Br, S, or other element patterns are present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
